Oral Judgment
This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 11.01.2022 passed by the V Additional District and Sessions Judge and Member, MACT-XIII, Vijayapura, in MVC No.86 of 2017.

sentences.text: 2. The facts of the case are that, on 20.11.2015, while the claimant was travelling in the KSRTC Bus bearing registration No.KA-42/F-958 from Vijayapura to Solapur, NC: 2025:KHC-K:6490 HC-KAR Maharashtra State, the driver of the said bus drove it in high speed and rash and negligent manner and hit against the Lorry bearing registration No.MH-04/FJ-3515, which was coming from opposite direction and thereby caused the accident, due to which, claimant sustained fracture injuries.
3. The injured claimant, aged 56 years filed a claim petition before the Tribunal, claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/-.

The Tribunal, considering the entire evidence on record, granted compensation of Rs.61,100/- with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realisation and directed respondent No.3-Corporation to deposit the same.

sentences.text: Aggrieved by the said judgment and award, the injured claimant has preferred this appeal, in which it is contended that, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is meagre; he examined the Doctor as PW.2 and he assessed the disability at 10 to 12% and also issued disability certificate as per Ex.P7, but the Tribunal erred in NC: 2025:KHC-K:6490 HC-KAR rejecting the same; he was admitted in the hospital for 13 days as per Ex.R1 - discharge summary; no amounts are granted towards conveyance charges and loss of future income.
Therefore, requested for enhancement of the compensation.

5. Heard the arguments of both sides.
6.

As per Ex.P5 - Wound Certificate, the appellant sustained the following injuries:
"1. Abrasion on rr. pinna 5cm x 3xm x 2cm 2. Contusion on rt. parietal area 10cm x 4cm 3. Contusion on rt. upperarm 5cm x 4cm 4. Contusion on rt. side of chest 12cm x 4cm.
Radiology: 1) Comminuted displaced fracture of 3rd, 9th, 2nd to 8th ribs on right side 2) Comminuted fracture of right clavicle 3) Fracture of Glenoid cavity of right scapula"
The doctor assessed the disability under Ex.P7 as 10 to 12%.

As the appellant has not sustained any future loss NC: 2025:KHC-K:6490 HC-KAR of income, the disability was not considered by the Tribunal and no amount was granted towards loss of future income, which in the opinion of this Court is just and proper.
7.
As per the discharge summary, the appellant was admitted in the hospital for 14 days.

Considering the nature of injuries and period of hospitalisation, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.75,000/- for pain and suffering, Rs.30,000/- for loss of amenities, Rs.10,000/- for medical expenses and Rs.30,000/- for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
8. The appellant met with an accident on 20.11.2015.
He sustained fracture injuries and was hospitalised for 14 days.

Therefore, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.50,000/-
for loss of income during laid up period.

9. Hence, the appellant is entitled for the modified compensation under different heads as below:
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6490 HC-KAR Pain and suffering Rs.75,000/-
Medical expenses Rs.10,000/-
Transportation, extra nourishment, Rs.30,000/-

3 and attendant charges Loss of income during laid up period Rs.50,000/-
Loss of amenities Rs.30,000/-
Total Rs.1,95,000/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.61,100/-
Enhancement Rs.1,33,900/-

sentences.text: Thus, the appellant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.1,33,900/- with interest at 6% per annum and therefore, the appeal deserves to be allowed in part.

10. In the result, the following order is passed:
 (i) Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The appellant/claimant is entitled for the enhanced compensation of Rs.1,33,900/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
However, as per the order on I.A.1/2022 dated 09.02.2024, the appellant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 152 days in filing the appeal.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6490 HC-KAR (iii) Respondent No.3-Corporation is directed to deposit the aforesaid compensation amount within one month from the date of this judgment.
(iv) On such deposit, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with interest accrued on it.
